parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The name of the project to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of projects to return per request. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for paging. Leave this parameter empty or do not specify this character for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: ReviewRuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the audit policy.
> You can invoke the ListReviewRules operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description:
The number of entries to skip.

> This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty.
